findings.summary: A process-local static serialization dictionary has no explicit eviction bound (not a log/HTTP/persisted-state path).
findings.detail: ArtworkSubjectGate.Gates is a static ConcurrentDictionary<string, SemaphoreSlim> keyed by Jellyfin item GUID + image surface (ArtworkSubjectGate.cs:17,33). It is acquired from ArtworkPublisher (126, 525) and ArtworkReconciler (104) and has no TryRemove/Clear/eviction, so one SemaphoreSlim is retained per distinct (item, surface) ever processed for the process lifetime. Growth is not attacker-controllable and is bounded in practice by the number of distinct Jellyfin library items (which Jellyfin itself holds in memory), and it is neither a log, diagnostics, nor a persisted-state path. It therefore does not change the task's in-scope negative result, but it is the one inspected concurrency structure without an explicitly enforced bound, so it is recorded per the sweep requirement.
evidence: All other concurrency/queue/cache/artifact/payload paths have explicit bounds (LibraryWorkQueue capacity 512 + finally CompleteProcessing, WebhookIntake 256, WebhookCoalescingWindow 4x, WorkerCount 4, DynamicConcurrencyLimiter, StateRepository.MaxEnumerationRecords 100k, retention TTL/quota).
findings.recommended_action: Optional future hardening: periodically drop idle gate entries (e.g., on uninstall/lifecycle drain or an LRU bound). Not required for task 7.4.

findings.summary: The 401 webhook response carries a framework ProblemDetails body, while ADR-012's text says 'no body'; the body reveals nothing and was accurately reported.
findings.detail: Live requests to POST /ArrTags/Webhook/{Sonarr,Radarr} returned 401 with application/problem+json containing only type/title/status/traceId (ASP.NET Core [ApiController] automatic client-error ProblemDetails); ADR-012 section 'Authentication and constant-time comparison' says every failure returns the same bounded 401 'with no body'. No secret, header, body, or configuration detail is reflected, and the worker report describes the actual behavior accurately. This is a minor wording/behavior gap in the ADR, not a leakage or unbounded-data defect.
evidence: docs/decisions.md ADR-012 (401 with no body); ArrTagsWebhookController.ReceiveAsync returns Unauthorized() under [ApiController]
findings.recommended_action: No action required for task 7.4. If desired, task 7.6 can note the framework ProblemDetails body when documenting webhook behavior.
